stem:
Rakesh makes two simple pendulums of the same length at the same place. Pendulum P has a light bob. Pendulum Q has a heavier bob. He sets both swinging with small oscillations.

Which statement about their time periods is correct?

options.text: P and Q have the same time period, because time period depends on length, not on the mass of the bob.
Q has a longer time period, because time period depends on the mass of the bob, not on length.
P and Q have the same time period at every place, because length alone fixes the time period everywhere.
Any object of this length that moves back and forth has this time period at this place.

teacher.key_rationale: At a given place, a simple pendulum’s time period for small swings depends on length, not bob mass. Place still matters; not every back-and-forth object is a simple pendulum with that period.
